Subject: Unexpected surge in November 30 ingest / asking for per-request evidence

Hi Diego,

We noticed a sharp spike on our Nov 30 invoice (line item: ingest tokens) that pushed us over the committed tier. Our finance team flagged ~1.2M additional tokens between 22:30-23:10 UTC and we're trying to understand the root cause. Can you provide per-request breakdowns for that 40-minute window (request_id, endpoint, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, timestamp) and any evidence of duplicate/replay traffic?

I attached a short CSV with the rows we see on our side (greenloop_overage_window.csv). We suspect a batch job replayer inadvertently replayed a queued bundle — if you can confirm a replay or double-count on Redwood's side, we'll need a retroactive credit and a VAT note for our accounting team.

Quick asks:
- Per-request logs for 2026-11-30 22:20–23:15 UTC (UTC timestamps please)
- Any tracing or request IDs that show duplicate retries
- Provisional credit estimate and how VAT will be handled for the adjustment (we're EU-registered)

Appreciate a quick acknowledgement and ETA — our month-close is Friday.

Best,
Emma Rios

emma@greenloop.ai
+44 20 5555 0101

Diego / Emma — I pulled the per-request telemetry for GL-3921 and attached a short analysis (burst-analysis-20261208.csv) and a provisional credit calc (provisional-credit-calc.xlsx). Summary: 

- Window analyzed: 2026-11-30 22:15:00–23:20:00 UTC.
- Total tokens billed (platform): 1,278,420 tokens.
- Tokens observed from upstream request_ids: 639,210 unique request_ids; however, we detect a replay pattern where ~620,500 tokens were duplicated due to a batch reprocessing job that retried a payload group with identical request signatures.
- Root cause: an edge requeue on our ingest buffer (internal flag INGT-RETRY) triggered a single queued bundle to be replayed by the ingest worker pool when a transient I/O timeout occurred. The runtime deduplication guard didn't catch the payload because the retry altered a soft-metadata header (x-client-batch-seq) by one byte.

Provisional remediation proposal:
- Credit the duplicated portion: 620,500 tokens x customer rate — provisional credit = 620,500 tokens * 0.0009 USD/token = 558.45 USD (rounded).
- VAT handling (EU): we will issue a credit memo for the gross billed amount and provide a VAT adjustment note referencing your VAT registration ID if you provide it. The credit memo will include line items and VAT reversal instructions for your finance team.

Attachments: burst-analysis-20261208.csv (per-request sample + flagged request_ids), provisional-credit-calc.xlsx (calc and rounding rationale).

Next steps I propose:
1) Emma: confirm you want Redwood to proceed with a credit memo for 558.45 USD (gross) and send your VAT registration ID for invoicing notes.
2) Diego / Marissa: I will open internal incident INGT-5509 to track the ingest requeue fix and follow up with the runtime team on a dedupe hardening task.

Diego: tagging Marissa for final approval on the credit amount and for billing to prepare the formal memo and invoice adjustment.

— Monica
